title: Split launch preflight tests by feature
summary: Split 16 read-only launch-preflight tests into a feature-scoped module, extract narrow shared facade fixtures, and refresh test inventory plus generated feature navigation without changing production behavior.
reason: The 4,534-physical-line process-launch test module mixed launch execution, Network lifecycle, rerun recovery, and read-only preflight policy. Moving one behavior-owned tranche makes focused selection and code-context retrieval more obvious while preserving discovery and assertions.
behavior_before: Launch-preflight coverage was embedded in test_application_facade_process_launch.py, which contained 81 tests and 4,534 physical lines (4,165 by the existing Measure-Object baseline). The committed duplicate report was already stale at 3,531 definitions; the initial live-worktree generator baseline was 3,690 definitions and 9 duplicate bare names.
behavior_after: The 16 unchanged launch-preflight test names live in test_application_facade_launch_preflight.py (992 physical / 929 measured lines). The original 81-test name set remains identical across the split cluster, and assertion AST fingerprints for all 16 moved tests are unchanged. Concurrent non-overlapping Network extractions further reduced the live process-launch file and are not attributed to this packet.
tests_added: No net-new tests: 16 existing launch-preflight tests moved without renaming to tests/python/desktop/test_application_facade_launch_preflight.py.
manual_validation: Pre-change: bundled Python unittest ran 81 tests in test_application_facade_process_launch and passed.
Post-change: bundled Python unittest ran 16 focused preflight tests and passed.
Post-change: bundled Python unittest ran all 81 tests across process launch, preflight, Network lifecycle, and Network rerun launch and passed.
AST comparison confirmed the original and current 81-test name sets are identical and all 16 moved assertion fingerprints match.
Ruff passed for the shared support, residual process-launch, and new preflight modules.
Generated duplicate-name report is current at 3,735 Python test definitions and 9 duplicate bare names; the moved tranche added no duplicate.
Generated project index/dependency graph and feature map checks passed; queue-launch and desktop-application feature cards select the new module.
Feature-context, active-doc, summary-integrity, god-file guard, and WebView inventory tests passed.
Test-WebViewBrowserLaunchQueueReadinessSmoke.ps1 ran 2 tests with no skips and passed its read-only/no-POST boundary.

Change packet schema validation passed for 1,109 packets. Strict whole-worktree coverage remained red only for 74 unrelated concurrent files; none of this packet's touched files were listed as uncovered.
rollback_plan: Move the 16 methods back into ApplicationFacadeProcessLaunchTests, restore the two tiny fixture builders locally, remove the focused preflight module, then regenerate summaries, project/feature navigation, inventories, and the duplicate-name report.
